ticket.title: Screening engine change — release 1
ticket.text: Legacy reference: Legacy Screen. Release changes Screening Engine. Implementation date: 2026-11-14. Change type: SYSTEM_CHANGE.

decisions.proposer_reason: Screening Engine generates alerts reviewed by this control.
decisions.proposer_counter: No evidence of unrelated function.
decisions.checker_reason: The changed system S03 (Screening Engine) could generate alerts that are reviewed by control C03, but no explicit edge or rule linking S03 to C03 is present in the available metadata.
decisions.checker_counter: No visible edge or rule connects S03 to C03; the only edges from S03 are to D12 and several other controls (C022‑C029).

decisions.proposer_reason: Screening Engine feeds daily alert data reviewed here.
decisions.proposer_counter: No evidence of unrelated function.
decisions.checker_reason: Potential functional chain: S03 (Screening Engine) produces screening disposition data (D12) that would be consumed by C030 (daily completeness control) in the screening review process. However, no explicit edge linking D12 or S03 to C030 is visible.

decisions.proposer_counter: No evidence shows exemption
